subject: Audit logging capabilities — SOC 2, exportability, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logging follow-up & attachments

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the items I promised to share:

1) What we capture (high level)
- Admin activity logs: user sign-ins, role changes, admin UI actions (who, what, when).
- API request logs: request metadata (timestamp, endpoint, response code, latency), headers, and optionally request/response payloads (see note below).
- System events: model deployments, rollback events, autoscaling actions.

2) Export & retention options
- Near real-time export to your S3/GCS bucket or to an event stream (Kafka).
- Daily and ad-hoc export jobs (CSV/JSON) via the Console or API.
- Retention policies configurable per-account; enterprise tiers can lock retention with WORM/object-lock patterns for immutability.

3) Immutability & tamper evidence
- For Dedicated/Private deployments we support immutable exports using S3 Object Lock + Glacier Vault Lock patterns and retention-lock configurations.
- Hosted customers can enable managed export with retention controls and cryptographic checksums for tamper detection; fully immutable long-term storage is available as an enterprise add-on.

4) Security & compliance status
- SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type I and is in progress on Type II (expected Q3 2026). We can provide the SOC 2 Type I report and a bridge letter on request.
- Data protection: encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.2+). KMS integrations available for Dedicated/Private (customer-managed keys).
- GDPR/HIPAA: we support data residency controls and will sign a BAA for Private/Dedicated deployments.

Attached: audit_log_overview.pdf (short whitepaper) and audit_log_sample.csv (sample export).

Next steps I propose:
- I can loop in Nikhil (our security technical lead) for a 30-min call to walk your security team through the implementation details and the vendor questionnaire.
- If you want the vendor security questionnaire filled out, feel free to upload it to our secure intake link or I can initiate the questionnaire exchange (DocuSign/secure upload).

Are you available Wed/Thu this week for a 30-min technical sync?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
Attachment: audit_log_overview.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: audit_log_sample.csv (text/csv)
From: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging follow-up & attachments

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. A few follow-ups from our security team before we schedule the technical deep-dive:

- Immutability: can you confirm whether "immutable exports" are fully WORM (write-once) for hosted customers, or only for Dedicated/Private? We need guarantees for forensic evidence retention.
- Full request/response bodies: by default are request bodies stored or only metadata? If bodies are stored, how long and are they redacted/truncated by default?
- Key management: do you support BYOK (bring-your-own-key) and HSM-backed keys for encryption at rest?
- Access controls & auditability: can we get per-principal audit trails with session identifiers and IP address logging?
- SOC 2 timeline: please share the Type I report and any expected dates for Type II.

Also — we have a vendor security questionnaire (attached). What's the best way to get that to you and track a response?

Tom
Tom Jenkins
Director, IT Security
Acme Corp
tom.jenkins@acme.com

---
Attachment: Acme_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logging follow-up & attachments

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list. Answers below (short) and Nikhil and Dev are copied to jump in with technical specifics on the call.

- Immutability:
  * Hosted: we provide tamper-evident exports and cryptographic checksums; full WORM object-lock setups (legal retention) are available as an enterprise add-on where Redwood manages the object lock for the export bucket.
  * Dedicated/Private: full WORM/object-lock patterns are supported and we can use customer-managed S3/GCS buckets with Object Lock enabled for legal-hold style retention.

- Request/response bodies:
  * Default: we store metadata (headers, endpoint, status, latency) and truncated payloads for troubleshooting (first/last N KB).
  * Enterprise option: full request/response capture is available with customer opt-in. Storage duration for full payloads is configurable; default retention is 30 days unless extended per contract.
  * Redaction: we offer automatic sensitive-field redaction rules (PII patterns) for captured payloads on request.

- Key management:
  * Yes — BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). HSM-backed keys are supported for Private deployments.

- Access controls & auditability:
  * Per-principal audit trails with session ids, IP addresses, and role-change history are included in admin activity logs.
  * Logs include user agent, source IP, and session identifiers for traced actions.

- SOC 2:
  * Attached: SOC2-letter.pdf (Type I report). SOC 2 Type II is in progress; expected completion Q3 2026. We will provide the Type II report when available and can share a bridge letter in the meantime.

Vendor questionnaire: please upload the Acme_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf to our secure intake portal (DocuSign/secure upload) — I can initiate the exchange and track it in our HubSpot record. If you prefer, I'm happy to take the first pass and return a redlined copy within 3 business days.

Related resources:
- Audit logging docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/audit-logging
- Export API: https://redwood.example.com/docs/export-api

Proposed next step: 30-min technical sync on Thu, Jun 18 at 3:00 PM PT with Nikhil (security lead) and Dev (solutions engineer). Does that work for your team?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

See you then.

Tom
